title: Light Flaky Australian Fish Pie
description: A savory Australian dish featuring Thai sweet basil, perfect for a solo dinner, with a flaky crust and delicious fish filling, made with dash-friendly ingredients and a simple boil method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice cold water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cod fillets, Thai sweet basil, egg, and lemon juice.
Place the fish mixture onto one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the fish is cooked through.
